name: asb-skill-collections
description: Curated, evidence-grounded scientific-agent skill and tool collections from the AgenticScienceBuilder pipeline.

plugins.name: metabolomics
plugins.description: ASB Metabolomics. Computational metabolomics (predominantly LC-MS/MS; also LC-MS, GC-MS, NMR, mass-spectrometry imaging, ion mobility, lipidomics, multi-omics): spectral library matching, molecular networking, formula/structure annotation (SIRIUS), preprocessing, normalization, and statistics: 11,830 evidence-grounded skills over 1,989 tools, each derived from a method paper (journal article or preprint) and its code. Router-shaped: three skills are advertised (the router, the asb-metabolomics licence gate and the asb-contribute contribution route), the corpus ships as data and is retrieved on demand, so installing costs negligible context. Includes a Perspicacité KB auto-grounding binder.
